scripts/ci_select.py:scripts.ci_select.x.reason: Equivalent for current generated repository manifests: dep_manifest._executed constructs units as relative_path plus one :: separator plus an AST qualified name. _spans uses identifiers and dots, and the repository contains no filenames with ::. Each generated unit therefore has exactly one separator, so partition and rpartition return the same source path. This verdict does not cover arbitrary malformed strings or future filenames containing ::. Independently reviewed against preflight 40190427471.
